segments.name: healthcare technology
segments.description: Sells diagnostic testing and data and applications products, including Insights, Next, Trials and Algos, to physicians, researchers and life sciences companies.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Physicians, academic institutions, payers and pharmaceutical companies pay for genetic testing, data licensing, clinical trial matching and related services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company primarily derives revenue from selling comprehensive genetic testing to physicians and large academic research institutions, licensing data to third parties, matching patients to clinical trials, and related services.
